title: Hosanna hosanna

lines.text: Hosanna, Hosanna, Hosanna in the highest
Lord we lift up Your Name,
Be exalted Oh Lord my God,
Glory, Glory, Glory to the King of Kings
Glory, Glory, Glory to the King of Kings
Lord we lift up Your Name,
Be exalted Oh Lord my God,
Glory to the King of Kings.
